## Problem

Closes #NNN
<!-- One "Closes #NNN" line per issue this change resolves, or delete if none. -->

A short plain-language summary: what goes wrong, who it affects, and what this
change does about it.

## Approach

What changed and why this way. Mention an alternative only if a reviewer would
ask about it. Do not walk through the diff.

## Validation

One line per kind of check and its result; do not list tests by name. Name
required checks that were not run or did not pass.

## Evidence

| Before | After |
| ------ | ----- |
| | |

Device and commit:

## Risks

Compatibility, security, operational, or release impact, or "None identified".

## Checklist

- [ ] I read and can explain the complete diff.
- [ ] This pull request addresses one concern.
- [ ] The Evidence section shows every change a user can see, or how I checked a change nobody sees.
